maria: Postmortem follow-up: we've seen another KV eviction blip. Need a short, actionable playbook (3 checks), exact commands, owners and dates.

kevin: I can draft the playbook and open the PR. Will keep it to a one-page checklist for oncall.

sam: I'll add the diagnostic query and a brief note about prefix-length skew causing KV growth.

lisa: Product wants the rollback steps and a note on Dedicated opt-in for higher eviction thresholds.

akshay: oncall: can we get an "approved mitigation" action in the alert UI to run the safe commands? typing commands during pagers is risky.

maria: Proposed 3-step triage (short):
1) Confirm: `sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (model) > 50`
2) Contain: `redwoodctl models patch <model> --set cache.read_only=true` + scale pool if needed
3) Failover: shift traffic to fallback model if p95 > 500ms for 2m

kevin: Commands I'll include in PR:
```
redwoodctl models patch model-foo --set cache.read_only=true
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool model-foo-pool --add-replicas 2
redwoodctl traffic shift --from model-foo --to model-foo-quantized --percent 100
```
PR link (WIP): https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pull/1122

sam: I'll paste the diagnostic PromQL and attach a small harness for long-prefix traffic.

lisa: I'll add the customer-notify template and the rollback snippet: `redwoodctl models patch model-foo --set cache.read_only=false`

akshay: Filing infra ticket for mitigation button: INFRA-1610. I'll include required RBAC.

runbook-bot: Created action RB-1122 assigned to kevin, due 1767976520.

maria: Owners/timeline agreed: kevin -> PR by Thu EOD (1767976520), sam -> tests by next Tue (1768159320), maria -> staging smoke + merge by Fri (1768260000).

kevin: Will add a short TL;DR for oncall at the top and ping reviewers on Thursday morning.

maria: Add these to the postmortem action tracker and close after merge. If anyone needs to swap ownership, shout here. :thumbsup:
